description: §22.12 (S459 review HIGH, DOM clobbering) — a control named `lastChild` shadows the form's `lastChild`; a gate reading node.lastChild never saw the ``. Refused: nothing written.
rationale: §22.12 "Runtime `meta.emit` output is gated" step 2: the gate reads the parsed tree ONLY through accessors markup cannot shadow; on a violation it SHALL write NOTHING. (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S458 "a" + PA addendum 3 (S459 review of a7480c675))
